query: As a retiree aged 65 or older living in the United States, help me understand the loneliness epidemic among seniors and what I can do about it. I want to know (1) why social isolation has worsened for people in my age group, particularly since early 2020 and the onset of COVID-19, (2) how loneliness impacts my health and mental well-being, including specific health risks I should be aware of, (3) what community programs, technologies, and both in-person and digital solutions effectively help seniors stay connected — including government initiatives, nonprofit programs, and grassroots efforts, and (4) practical steps I can take to protect myself and support other seniors in my community. Please provide real examples, success stories, and practical resources with detailed information wherever possible.
